notes: Compact indoor mini box network camera (2MP/1080p), not rack-mountable — rackUnits omitted. Two independent power paths exist: PoE via the RJ45 jack, or 5V/1.5A via USB-C; only one is needed. Official manufacturer spec sheet lists no separate video output, alarm I/O, or analog audio jacks — audio in is via two built-in omnidirectional microphones (not an external port) and there is no audio output. A microSD card slot (up to 512GB) is present for onboard storage but is not a signal/power connector type covered by the requested connector list, so it was omitted. Product page indicates this exact model (WV-S71300-F3) is discontinued, superseded by WV-S71300A-F3; specs above are for the originally requested F3 model per its own manufacturer datasheet (rev. 231204). Datasheet PDF filename: "WV-S71300-F3 _ i-PRO US_R2_231204.pdf", confirming this is the authoritative US spec sheet from i-pro.com.

ports.name: Network (RJ45)
ports.note: 10Base-T/100Base-TX; also carries PoE (IEEE 802.3af, Class 0 device, DC48V 170mA ~8.2W) to power the camera.

ports.name: DC IN (USB Type-C)
ports.note: DC5V/1.5A (~7.5W) power input; USB Power Delivery not supported. Datasheet separately lists a USB2.0 (480Mbps theoretical) serial interface, believed to be this same connector.
